VAR _CurrentYear = [Total Budget]
VAR _PreviousYear = CALCULATE(
    [Total Budget],
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Calendar'[Date]))
VAR _Growth = 
DIVIDE(
    _CurrentYear - _PreviousYear, 
    _PreviousYear)
RETURN
SWITCH(
    TRUE(),
    _Growth > 0, "#01cf11",
    _Growth < 0, "#d65279",
    "Grey"
)

VAR _LY = 
CALCULATE(
    [Total Budget],
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Calendar'[Date]))
RETURN
" vs " & FORMAT(_LY, "$#,##0,,.00 M")  & " Last Year"
